prompt: Take this aerial street picture and alter just two things. First, erase the white parking-bay lines painted along both kerbs, so the tarmac carries only a dashed white centre line and a thin double yellow line at each edge. Second, render it crisp and noise-free, like a modern digital drone photo with no film grain. Everything else stays as it is: all the broken bricks, slates, rubble heaps and weeds scattered across the road surface and pavements, the robot and its spot on the road, the wrecked roofs, the burnt-out car, the camera height and angle, and the grey overcast daylight.
